authorityClaim: This artifact AUTHORS independently reviewable harness specifications for the five already-named identifiers harness.DR-G01.core-download, harness.DR-G02.core-installed, harness.DR-G03.core-startup, harness.DR-G04.core-memory, and harness.DR-G05.component-delta. Naming already existed (D-086 / D-102). This is the OBL-2 authoring D-160 left open. It does not execute any harness. It does not claim QUALIFIED or DEMONSTRATED. It does not SATISFY DR-101. It does not decide OD-101-1 or OD-101-2. It does not invent D-006 numerals, G05 caps, or machines beyond the adopted D-102 fleet class. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Close leftover-design of unauthored G01-G05 harness specifications (D-056 Decision clause 5 / DCLJ-V1-B1 / D-160 OBL-2) without performing execution or SATISFIED.

d102.role: Hosted-fleet-class measurement contract governing G03/G04 execution protocol. Exact-machine / exact-OS superseded for G03 and G04 only. This specification does not re-decide that contract.

discipline: SPECIFICATIONS OF EXACT-BYTE INTENT for retained evidence. No harness runs here. Nothing here is executed evidence. QUALIFIED remains condition 4 / DR-012.

threshold.bound: signed compressed distribution-core ≤ 25 MB per platform
threshold.excludes: every language runtime closure (DR-119 / G14 component, not this core)

harnesses.measures: The signed compressed distribution-core closure that v16 names signedDistributionCore: native executable plus its mandatory runtime/data closure. Boundary is packaging, install, update, trust, management/recovery footprint. defaultInstall.excludes stay excluded.
harnesses.exactByteIntent: Per platform: the compressed signed artifact bytes, their sha256, declared size in bytes, signature set, SBOM, and the published artifact list. The fixture pins those artifacts and the arithmetic that the declared size is ≤ 26214400 bytes.
harnesses.passProperty: For each of the four platforms, the pinned compressed signed closure is ≤ 25 MB and contains no language-runtime, analyzer, graph-engine, report-generator, evidence-database, or telemetry-backend member of defaultInstall.excludes.
failsIf: any platform's compressed signed closure exceeds 25 MB
a language-runtime closure is counted inside the core
the published artifact list and the hashed bytes disagree
signatures or SBOM required by the inventory are absent
harnesses.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Does not decide OD-101-1 or OD-101-2.

threshold.bound: immutable installed tree ≤ 80 MB; mandatory-closure inventory enumerated
threshold.qualitativeHalf: zero undeclared dependencies is DR-126 / G22 (v16 ID-DEP-K2). This specification records inventory completeness structure and does not decide L-TCB identity.

harnesses.measures: The immutable installed tree of the default install. v16 inventorySchema.everyReleaseMustPublish members that this gate owns: complete mandatory file/dependency/TCB inventory and layer assignment; exact installed closure size.
harnesses.exactByteIntent: Per platform: a digest-pinned inventory graph matching v16 inventorySchema.graphRules, the installed-tree size in bytes, and a layer assignment for every node. The fixture pins the inventory bytes and the arithmetic that installed size is ≤ 83886080 bytes.
harnesses.passProperty: For each of the four platforms, the installed immutable tree is ≤ 80 MB, every published file node is in the inventory, layer-set cardinality obeys v16 graphRules, and the shared executable if present is exactly one {L-DIST, L-HOST} node.
failsIf: any platform's installed tree exceeds 80 MB
a published file is absent from the inventory
duplicate path or duplicate sha256 under a different path
an exclusive-layer violation (L-EVAL or L-COMP co-occurring with another layer, other than the lawful {L-DIST, L-HOST} shared executable)
this specification is read as deciding L-TCB identity
harnesses.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Does not populate the per-OS TCB table. Does not retarget DR-126.

harnesses.claimVerbatim: `--help`/`--version` remain fast and load no components/project

threshold.source: D-006 clause 3 plus D-102 fleet class

harnesses.fleetClass: Adopted D-102 hosted-fleet-class measurement contract. Labels: macos-15 (arm64, 3-core, 7 GB), macos-15-intel (native Intel VM, UDID 4203018E-580F-C1B5-9525-B745CECA79EB), ubuntu-24.04 (x64, 4 CPU, 16 GB), ubuntu-24.04-arm (arm64, 4 CPU, 16 GB). Never Rosetta. macos-26-intel is not this class. Private 2 CPU / 8 GB is not this class.
harnesses.protocol: D-102 turn-2 subject 7780190e… governs N=21, nearest-rank estimator (p50=11, p95=20, p99=21), thin-only projection, preflight, path/digest identity, Linux and macOS target-process protocols, and the paired 10% formula from the second qualified release. This specification does not amend that protocol.
harnesses.exactByteIntent: Per platform and command: 21 accepted job records, each carrying runs-on label, P, D0, I0, cold and warm latencies, process/module trace proving no component or project load, and preflight architecture fields. The fixture pins those records and the five operative rank values.
harnesses.passProperty: For each platform and each of --help and --version: cold p50/p95/p99 and warm p95/p99 meet D-006 bounds; every accepted job used the D-102 class label; the process/module trace shows no component and no project load; thin-only preflight passed; never Rosetta.
failsIf: any operative percentile exceeds its D-006 bound
N < 21 accepted jobs for a governed series
a fat/universal image is used as the measurement projection
Rosetta-on-Apple-Silicon is used for macos-x86_64
a component or project is loaded
this specification invents a machine identifier outside D-102
harnesses.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Warm p50 is telemetry and must not fail qualification (D-102).

threshold.explicitlyOutside: analyze RSS and doctor-with-consented-probes RSS remain outside D-006

harnesses.matrix: same D-102 fleet class; --help/--version cold/warm RSS plus one doctor read-only launch per sample
harnesses.protocol: D-102 G04 series: 21 samples; every accepted sample must be ≤ the D-006 bound (not only the percentile). doctor read-only is one launch per sample, no warm pair. Path/digest identity and preflight are the D-102 contract.
harnesses.exactByteIntent: Per platform: 21 RSS traces for --help, --version, and doctor read-only, each with steady and peak, plus the raw methodology record. The fixture pins those traces and the comparison of every sample to the bound.
harnesses.passProperty: Every accepted sample is ≤ its D-006 bound. --help/--version use the same cold/warm pairing as G03. doctor read-only is one launch. analyze and consented-probe RSS are not scored.
failsIf: any accepted sample exceeds its bound
analyze or consented-probe RSS is scored as this gate
doctor read-only is given a warm pair as if it were help/version
Rosetta or a non-D-102 class is used
harnesses.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Does not invent analyze RSS bounds.

harnesses.claimVerbatim: Each component cost is independently visible

threshold.bound: measurement and visibility mandatory; NO numeric cap in D-006
threshold.trigger: slice-1 TypeScript provider is a component; the trigger fires in this slice's qualification cycle

harnesses.matrix: D-002 platform × component (slice-1: the TypeScript provider)
harnesses.measures: download, install, start, and RSS delta of that component against the core measured at G01-G04.
harnesses.exactByteIntent: Per platform: four published delta numbers (download bytes, installed bytes, start latency, RSS) for the TypeScript provider, each with methodology and the core baseline they subtract from. The fixture pins those published records. Absence of a published delta is a fail. Exceeding a numeric cap is not a fail because no cap exists here.
harnesses.passProperty: Every slice-1 component has published download/install/start/RSS deltas on all four platforms. Caps are not applied.
failsIf: any of the four deltas is unpublished for a slice-1 component on a slice-1 platform
this specification is read as inventing a numeric cap
a language-runtime closure is hidden inside the core instead of appearing as a component delta
harnesses.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Does not invent caps. Caps become product decisions at the first component-acceptance decision.

regressionRule.source: D-006 clause 6 as specialized by D-102 for G03/G04
regressionRule.domain: CORE quantities of G01-G04 only. G05 deltas are visibility-only until a later cap decision.
regressionRule.fromSecondQualifiedRelease: G03 paired 10% on D-102's five operative percentiles; G04 paired 10% on medians of the 21 samples; G01/G02 10% against the previous qualified release's measured compressed and installed sizes. Improvements unbounded.
regressionRule.waiver: product AND release authority, expiry, measured residual; never waives an inherited semantic/trust blocker

whatThisCloses.reason: OD-101-1 (core language reserved) and OD-101-2 (signing ceremony reserved) remain leftover-design. This specification does not decide them.
